# Board UI fixtures

B01 files contain fictional exact-price data from isolated H2 tests. Reference files replay the recorded 2026-10-09 catalog through isolated H2; the snapshot file includes an explicit synthetic one-cent revision control. These are API/UI test inputs, not production exports or verification of current price, inventory, compatibility, or authenticated production writes. Accounts/tokens used by browser mocks are fictional. Do not import these fixtures into production.
